messages:
jon: kicking off PHX1 'aurora' bring-up quick sanity run now. aim: smoke + SLO gates + handoff.

maria: quick checklist: nodes=6 (3 p4, 3 t4), kube 1.27, nvidia-driver 545. best-effort for auto-scaling policies.

neal: running node readiness check

ash: threw in a tiny script to verify GPUs & nvlink:
```
kubectl -n infra run gpu-check --rm --restart=Never --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1-base -- bash -c "nvidia-smi && python -c 'import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())'"
```

deploy-bot: deploy job #aurora-bootstrap-92 started

maria: network sanity: MTU 9000 across phx-subnet-a/b, iptables DNAT rules present, NAT gateways attached to public route.

neal: perf quickcheck: ping between worker pods p95=1.2ms, tcp handshake median=0.9ms

jon: SLO gates proposed for handoff:
- control-plane API p95 < 150ms
- kube-scheduler latency p95 < 200ms
- node GPU readiness >= 95%
- sustained GPU util during test <= 75% (no throttling)
- pod evictions = 0
- egress bandwidth for batching path > 1.5Gbps

ash: cost note: estimated incremental monthly GPU charge ~ $28k for this pool at current utilization. flagging for finance sync.

maria: running model-inference smoke: start small container that runs a 512-token prompt x50, measure p95 token latency

neal: small data: 50 runs, p95 token-step latency = 38ms, end-to-end 95th = 142ms (within target)

jon: health checks to pass for handoff (manual verifications):
- all control-plane pods in Running
- disk pressure = 0
- kubelet version match across nodes
- driver manager logs no CUDA errors
- node-exporter metrics flowing into prometheus
- E2E tracing link visible in console

maria: added quick commands for runbook in case of failures:
```
# if nvidia-dkms failed
ssh node-1 && journalctl -u nvidia-dkms -n 200
# restart kubelet
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
```

ash: found one node with driver bind failure, restarted driver pod, now shows 6/6 GPUs ready :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary traffic routing set to 20% -> aurora1, fallback policy enabled

jon: raising handoff: oncall-phx, all gates green except cost approval. please ack and take over for 24h monitoring window.

oncall-phx: acked. will monitor p95s and node restarts, set alert threshold: GPU-ready-drop > 5% in 10m -> paging.

maria: leaving a note in runbook: 'if sustained token step p95 rises > 20% vs baseline, rollback canary to previous model variant and scale up burst pool.'

neal: logging this thread in the cluster-handovers doc and closing the bring-up loop.

jon: thanks everyone. handoff complete :tada:
